create.name: Centre de Yoga Iyengar de Paris
create.bio:
Centre de Yoga Iyengar de Paris is one of the oldest Iyengar schools in France. Faeq Biria, a close student of B.K.S. Iyengar who helped set up Iyengar teacher training and certification in many countries and contributed to several of his teacher's books, opened it in 1980; since 1989 it has occupied a high-ceilinged ground-floor room on the avenue Victor Hugo in the 16th arrondissement, which Iyengar himself inaugurated in 1990. Since Faeq's death in 2022 it has been directed by Corine Biria, who began yoga in 1981, studied in Pune for many years and has led teacher trainings in France and abroad, with a team of teachers trained by Faeq.

Classes run seven days a week at several levels, mostly ninety minutes long, with two-hour advanced sessions, classes for children, teenagers and older students, and some two-hour classes with Corine streamed online. Monthly Saturday workshops revisit the basics or one family of poses, seasonal intensives are held in winter, at Easter and in summer, and year-long study cycles deepen practice, teaching skill and philosophy, including a mentored path towards Iyengar certification.

courses.title: Cours de yoga: tarifs (classes, class cards and unlimited pass)
courses.description: Weekly Iyengar classes at the centre, from beginners to advanced, bought as single classes, class cards or a 30-day unlimited pass, with a few two-hour classes online. Reduced rates apply to students under 26, job seekers and people over 75.
courses.price: Cours d'essai d'1h30: 23 €; Pack Bienvenue (3 séances en 2 semaines): 49 €; Cours d'1h30: 34 € (réduit 23 €); Carte de 10 cours d'1h30: 300 € (réduit 201 €); Abonnement illimité: 220€/mois; Carte de 16 cours en ligne de 2h avec Corine: 400 €

courses.title: Atelier Reprise des bases – Niveau 1 – 14 novembre
courses.description: A three-hour Saturday workshop for beginners that goes back over the foundations of the method, taught by Bhavisha Desai. Places are limited and booking is required.

courses.title: Stage d'hiver 2026
courses.description: A weekend intensive at the centre for students at levels 3 and 3-4, led by Emily Megged over a Saturday afternoon and a full Sunday.

free_resources.title: Quelques conseils (guidance before and after practice)
free_resources.description: The centre's French-language guidance on how to prepare for a class and how to carry its quiet into the rest of the day, treating practice as both physical work and a sacred discipline.
